title: Map timeline events to warped audio clips: warp markers, mode, transpose, detune, gain
description:
## Intent

Map every `Event` of the timeline to an arrangement audio clip on its track's audio track.

## Steps

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/clips.rs`: for each `TrackInfo` an audio track (name, order as in the score); for each `Event` (`crates/apricity-score/src/compile.rs`) a clip at `start_beat` for `dur_beats`, its sample from `sources[event.source]`, warp markers from `event.warp` (source seconds → beats from the event's start) offset by the clip's start, warp mode from `event.mode` per `design/daw-set.md`.
- Pitch: `semitones` plus `tuning_cents` combined, then split into whole semitones and a detune inside the DAW's range (round to the nearest semitone).
- Level: read in compile.rs exactly which of level match, velocity and track `volume` are already in `Event.gain_db`; put the per-note part on the clip gain and the fader on the track volume, never counting anything twice. Record the finding in `design/daw-set.md`.
- Sample reference: duration and sample rate from the sample's manifest (`crates/apricity-score/src/manifest.rs`), no audio decoding.
- A track with no events: an empty track and a warning.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw` — the "Notes become arrangement clips" scenarios pass.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): notes become warped arrangement clips`. Not breaking.
